what_this_is: The narration track of presentation/out/tracetriage-film.mp4. Text generated from the film's own claims by presentation/scripts/build-narration.ts, spoken locally, then transcribed and checked figure by figure against what the receipts hold.
what_this_does_not_establish: That the narration is worth listening to. It establishes that every figure in it is a figure a receipt holds, and that no line overruns the card it is spoken over.

renderer.voice_chosen_by: measurement, not preference. Every male voice in these weights read the whole script and was ranked by figures heard, then by lines overrunning their card, then by word error rate. artifacts/VOICE_CASTING.json holds the table, losers included.

verifier.method: Every figure the narration names is looked for in the transcript of the rendered audio, on digits with grouping and punctuation normalised away.

beats.text: Of everything a ground station recorded last night, what should a person open first?

beats.text: Volunteers point radios at satellites and judge what came back by eye. This frozen snapshot holds two thousand seven hundred and twenty seven captures. Only 739 carry a decisive verdict. The rest were recorded, and nobody read them.
beats.transcript: Volunteers point radios at satellites and judge what came back by eye. This frozen snapshot holds 2,727 captures. Only 739 carry a decisive verdict. The rest were recorded and nobody read them.

figures.spoken: two thousand seven hundred and twenty seven

beats.text: From this pass's own orbital elements, propagated with S G P 4, the expected Doppler curve spans seventeen thousand two hundred and ninety hertz. Slide that curve 113 pixels and it lands on the trace. The gap is the measurement. plus thirteen thousand nine hundred and eighty five hertz, plus 32.05 parts per million. This station had already taken the Doppler out, and nothing in the observation record says so.

beats.text: Any agent can drive this over the Model Context Protocol. 7 read-only tools over the committed receipts, 5 more that measure a pass recorded today. Write a downlink frequency this observation does not have and the checker refuses it, naming the reason. Write only what its own packet prints and it passes. The recorded session ran 12 steps and 12 came back as documented.

beats.text: The gate written down in advance asked the queue to find one and a half times as many conflicts as random ordering at the same budget. It found 20 where random expects 12.6. That is a lift of 1.58. The interval runs 1.35 to 1.74, so it straddles the bar, and this is published as not established.

beats.text: Six gates, with their thresholds, written down before anything was measured. 3 of 6 were met. A point estimate above the bar whose interval crosses it counts as a failure here, which is stricter than the brief asked for. Nothing was moved to make a verdict look better.

beats.text: Three results came back decided. Read-only evidence tools take a local Granite model from 2 of 24 right to 22 of 24. The grounding checker caught 525 of 525 planted falsehoods, and refused 0 of 175 clean drafts. On stations the queue never saw, lift is 2.25, and that one clears.

beats.text: IBM Bob built the load-bearing pipeline. The data contracts, the immutable snapshot, the waterfall parser, the physics corridor, the label provenance, the baselines, the grouped splits and the queue: 10 dated units, each with the files it changed and what failed first. Every measurement here is computed on what those units produced.
